machinery_house_panels.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset type: seamless game base-colour / albedo texture for the broad sheet-steel machinery housing of Lowtide's red harbour cranes.
Input image: the existing generated oxide-red painted steel texture is the edit target and paint/material reference.
Primary request: turn this flat paint sample into a convincing four-panel steel cladding material, exactly a two-column by two-row grid. Four large flat steel panels, joined by very narrow continuous straight dark recessed seams: one perfectly straight vertical seam through the centre, one perfectly straight horizontal seam through the centre, and matching half-width seams exactly on the image edges for seamless tiling. Panels are flush, edges crisply defined with restrained raised overlap lips. Small realistic round bolt heads with hexagonal centres spaced regularly along both sides of the seams. Bolts and seams match the same red paint.
Materials: mostly intact aged oxide-red enamel, less speckled than the input: reduce tiny isolated black paint-loss dots by about half, preserve a few restrained chipped and grey bare-steel spots, slight elongated scratches and low-contrast uneven paint fading. Thin rust halos concentrated around some bolts and seams. Smooth fabricated steel, not a porous plaster wall. Colour stays the same desaturated oxide red as the input.
Scale: the square covers 3.25 metres; each panel about 1.6 metres square. Bolt heads are roughly 20 mm across, gaps 2–3 mm, restrained wear; do not make industrial parts oversized. Include a few subtle thin dirt runoff trails from the lower bolts.
Composition/framing: square high-resolution 2048 x 2048 orthographic front-on flat surface, fills every pixel edge to edge. Exactly seamless across opposite edges. Preserve the overall red colour and diffuse illumination of the input.
Lighting: evenly lit diffuse albedo, no cast shadows, no directional lighting or highlights, no vignette. Thin local crevice shading only along the joints and under bolt heads.
Constraints: only the flat steel material; no crane object, no scenery, no borders or wide external frame, no perspective, no wooden boards, corrugations, text, signs, hazard markings, labels, symbols, watermark. Grid must be regular 2 by 2, bolt detail small, chips sparse.

prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural.
Asset type: seamless production game base-colour / albedo material for the oxide-red painted steel of Lowtide's old harbour quay cranes, including large machinery-house sides and narrow structural beams.
Primary request: a sharp realistic square surface scan of aged industrial red-painted mild steel. Flat sheet metal completely fills the image edge to edge. Muted medium iron-oxide red paint, softly faded in irregular low-contrast patches, with crisp tiny scratches, subtle orange-peel paint texture, small chipped spots exposing dark cool grey steel, and restrained brown corrosion around a few chips. Salt-air wear and faint dirt runoff; maintained working equipment, not abandoned wreckage.
Scale and distribution: about 1.6 metres square of steel; mostly intact paint (about 90 percent), chips and scratches mostly 5–30 mm, a few irregular wear islands under 100 mm. Surface detail should read up close, gentle larger colour variation should read at a distance. Avoid uniform flat colour and avoid a noisy wall of heavy rust.
Composition/framing: orthographic straight-on flat material scan, square high-resolution 2048 x 2048, no perspective. Exactly seamless on all four edges, opposite edges must meet with matching colour and features. Weathering distributed naturally with no centre focal patch and no border wear.
Lighting: diffuse base colour only, uniformly lit, no baked highlights, no directional shadows, no shading gradients, no vignette or ambient occlusion.
Color palette: desaturated red oxide and faded warm red enamel; local graphite-grey exposed steel; restrained deep brown rust. Sufficient midtone lightness to remain readable on shaded in-game crane faces.
Constraints: only painted smooth steel surface, no crane image, no architecture, no wood grain, no cloth, no corrugations, no plate grids, no panel seams, no large rivets, no bolts, no handles, no borders, no lettering, no logo, no symbols, no watermark. Do not include scratches resembling words. No huge orange rust patches or strongly directional streak patterns.
